formDescription: Sub-screen for the 'childprotectionparent' request topic. Lets the applicant, requesting as the parent subject of a child protection investigation, select which record types they want. Note: the reporter of a child protection concern is never identified in released records.

child_protection_parent_selection.title: Select the corresponding types of records you would like to receive in your request
child_protection_parent_selection.description: The more selected, the larger the resulting request. Each main option, once checked, reveals its own set of record-type sub-options (each with an info tooltip describing that record type in the UI).

options.label: Child Protection Investigation Records (Family Service File)
options.value: Child Protection Investigation Records (Family Service File)

notes: Main/sub options are loaded dynamically from web/src/app/services/data.json (referenceData.childprotectionparent).
